FUNCTION longestSubstringLength(str):
    n <- LENGTH OF str
    seen <- EMPTY SET
    maxLen <- 0
    left <- 0
    FOR right FROM 0 TO n-1:
        WHILE str[right] IN seen:
            seen.remove(str[left])
            left <- left + 1
        ADD str[right] TO seen
        maxLen <- MAX(maxLen, right - left + 1)
    RETURN maxLen
